name: Generic webhook
description: Post task events from this project to any public HTTPS webhook (n8n, Zapier, Mattermost, Google Chat, custom listeners, and similar).

settings.label: Webhook URL
settings.description: HTTPS URL of the receiver. Private, loopback, and link-local addresses are rejected.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Choose which task events should be posted.

settings.label: Only notify when status changes (for task.updated)
settings.description: When enabled, task.updated is skipped unless the kanban or list status actually changed.
